description: Adopted Roads is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of York Council. Adopted roads in York. For further information about publicly maintainable adopted roads please visit the City of York Council website. Please note that the data published within this dataset is a live API link to CYC's GIS server. Coverage: City of York Council. The portal files it under the publisher City of York Council. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, KML. The portal shows 2020-01-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
